Definition: a Bakrite (collectively) or descendants of Beker
BiblicalUsage: The word names the family of Beker, counted among the sons of Ephraim in the wilderness census.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts families by name, and no clan is too small to be written down in His book.
